april: A man, he walked with men across a barren plain blue with flowers in brief April; they shared with him their anger, their barren helpless obduracy and the brief blue fire of their anger.
A Week in the Country (p. 133; first published in The Little Magazine (1976) Vol. 9, No. 4)
Really nothing happened on that gray afternoon in April. Everything, however, foretold a big day.
